proof.heading: What Does ChatGPT Say When Someone Asks About Your Brand?
proof.body: Comparing the best GEO company in India? Start with an audit of what AI tools say about your brand today, where they get it wrong and what to fix first.

faqs.a: Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) helps AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity understand, trust and cite your brand when they generate answers to user questions.

faqs.q: How is GEO different from AEO?
faqs.a: AEO helps your answers appear in Featured Snippets and People Also Ask. GEO helps AI tools mention and recommend your brand inside the answers they write.

faqs.q: Can GEO guarantee my brand appears in ChatGPT?
faqs.a: No. Nobody controls what AI tools say. GEO improves the signals they rely on: clear entities, consistent facts, credible sources and content that’s easy to cite.

faqs.q: Could my website be blocking AI tools?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Some sites block AI crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot or PerplexityBot without realising it. If crawlers can’t read your pages, AI tools can’t cite them.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best GEO agency in India?
faqs.a: Ask how they track AI citations, which platforms they monitor and how they fix inconsistent brand facts. The best GEO service in India for you measures mentions, not promises.

faqs.q: Why choose Reinvent Digital as your GEO company in India?
faqs.a: As a GEO company in India, Reinvent Digital fixes entity signals, structures content for AI and tracks citations across platforms, along with the enquiries they bring.
